scripts.dev: npm run build:engine && npm run build -w shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build:engine: mkdir -p engine/bin engine/.cache/go-build && GOCACHE=$PWD/engine/.cache/go-build go -C engine build -buildvcs=false -o bin/diplomacy-engine ./cmd/diplomacy-engine
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test -w server && npm run test:engine
